topic: doubling an A4 sheet until it covers Earth

package.title: Double A Sheet Of A4 Until It Covers The Earth
alt_titles: How Many Doublings To Cover Earth In Paper?
Why A4 Paper Is That Exact Size
description: Put two A4 sheets side by side and you get A3. Two A3s make A2, then A1, then A0, exactly 1 m². Every A-size has the same 1 : √2 shape, so you can keep doubling forever.
After 53 doublings the sheet is 563 million km², bigger than Earth's whole surface (510 million km²).
package.question: Which doubling surprised you? 👇
package.pinned: A-sizes are defined so that cutting one in half gives the next size with the same shape: the sides are in the ratio 1 : √2 (ISO 216) 📄
package.tiktok: Double a sheet of A4 until it covers the whole Earth. How many times? 📄 #math #paper #exponential
